pages.ld_description: Travel back in time to when dinosaurs roamed the earth with this dinosaur book for curious kids aged 6-8.Dinosaurs and other Prehistoric Life is a beautiful dinosaur encyclopedia for young readers aged 6-8, packed with fascinating information to captivate little learners as they travel through the history of the Earth.90 remarkable fossils, such as a fearsome Tyrannosaurus skull, delicate fern leaf, and perfectly preserved woolly mammoth, are each showcased through impressive illustrations, and children will love poring over the detailed close-up images. The storybook descriptions let you discover the myths and legends surrounding the organisms, as well as key facts about their natural history.This dinosaur book for children features: More than 90 species from the prehistoric world.Pronunciations of each and every dinosaur featured throughout.Detailed photographs of fossils and illustrations of each creature.A gold foil cover and metallic gold edges, making this an ideal gift. Encourage children to go on an adventure back in time and explore the prehistoric world, making this the ideal first reference book for kids aged 6-8 to enjoy for hours on end. Whether reading with the family or reading alone, this fun fact book also doubles up as the perfect gift for curious kids who love to learn.More in the SeriesDinosaurs and other Prehistoric Life is part of the beautiful and informative Anthology series.
